messages:
maria: Quick sync — post-launch iteration plan for the editor beta. Need to decide top 3 hotfixes vs 2 UX enhancements for the next 2-week sprint. Customer A flagged streaming truncation; internal metric shows ~4% failure spike.

alex: Can you paste a repro or traceID? I can take an initial look.

maria: Repro + logs uploaded to #support (traceID 0x9f2b). Main question: do we treat streaming truncation as P0 or P1? It's customer-visible.

jamal: If customers see errors it's P0. Our SLO alert fired twice yesterday. I can carve out a rollback window if we need an emergency patch.

sasha: From design: the compact-history enhancement is low risk and likely improves retention, but it doesn't address truncation.

lee: Estimate-wise: hotfix for streaming truncation ~2 dev days + 1 QA day. Compact history ~5 dev days. Which do we prioritize for immediate sprint?

olivia: Customer A and B both asked explicitly for the truncation fix. They're holding feature rollout until that's fixed.

maria: Proposal: hotfix-first. Sprint slots: 1) streaming hotfix (canary -> full after smoke), 2) backlog cleanup (crash logs that cropped up), 3) compact-history proto if bandwidth. Rollout criteria: post-canary failure <= 1% for 24h.

alex: Agree. For canary I'll add metric hooks: trace events + metric name 'stream.failure_rate' and set canary alert at 0.8%.

jamal: I'll provision a canary pool — suggest 10% traffic to dedicated canary pool and 2h short TTL for quick flips.

sasha: If compact-history goes in same sprint, scope it as a prototype behind a feature flag (no UX polish) + unit tests + short demo.

maria: Acceptance criteria for hotfix: repro removed on internal tests, no latency regression (> +10ms), and a rollback runbook. Who owns verification?

lee: I'll own verification. Plan: run regression harness on CI, smoke checks on canary, then manual signoff.

olivia: Keep sales looped — if we can give a timeline I'll coordinate with customers.

maria: Timeline proposal: day 0-1 triage & branch; day 2 canary; day 3 validation & full rollout. Compact-history starts day 3 if hotfix validated. Flag blockers by EOD.

alex: One blocker note: the fix touches the streaming buffer / KV cache path; need careful invariants checks. I'll open PR today and add detailed tests.

jamal: I'll coordinate with eng-oncall for rollback windows. Please tag the PR with 'incident-runbook' and drop the rollback steps inline.

maria: Thanks — scheduled quick sync at 11:15 to align owners. If you can't make it, drop a +1 or objections here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Heads-up — canary deployment window available tomorrow 09:00-12:00 UTC. Use tag 'canary/stream-hotfix'.

alex: Noted. I'll include metric dashboards and a link to the PR in the deploy description.

maria: Perfect. If anyone sees other customer blockers that should bump priority, call it out now.

lee: No other blockers from infra side. Proceeding with tests.

sasha: Will prepare quick before/after screenshots for the dashboard and the compact-history demo if we get it in.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the 11:15 sync with next steps.
